content.short: Create and mint NFTs on Cardano all in your browser for a very small fee - without trusting a third party for.
content.description: The most important feature of Cardano Studio are as follows: Bundling: Bundling as many NFTs into a single transaction as possible. Minimal fees: 2 ADA / transaction (where up to 100 NFTs can be minted within 1 transaction). No third party for minting: With Cardano Studio you get to sign and submit the transaction(s) on your own. No sending ADA to another address first. CSV support: Use your favorite offline tool to export your NFT collection as a CSV file and simply import it in Cardano Studio. Royalties: We support royalty fees following CIP 27.
content.meta: Find out about Cardano Studio (NFT TOOL) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
